module: Central manager of the "groups" (roads) of the Hero Road Editor. A group is a Lua table describing a road: nodes/widths/normals, cross-section profile, materials, marking layers, placed elements (crosswalks, repairs, potholes, widenings, intersections, barriers), groundmodel paint and Edit/Live state. The module creates, copies, splits, joins, serializes and deletes groups, applies profile presets, holds the undo/redo functions and drives the rebuild: updateDirtyGroups resamples the centerline then calls mesh, sidewalkMgr, barrierMgr and layerMgr in the right order.
usage:
local gm = extensions.editor_heroRoadEditor_groupMgr
gm.addNewGroup('My road')
local g = gm.getGroups()[#gm.getGroups()]
gm.applyProfilePreset(g, 'country')
gm.addCrossing(g, 0.5) -- crosswalk in the middle
-- g.isDirty = true is set: updateDirtyGroups(false) rebuilds on the next frame
notes: Each group is a SimGroup folder in MissionGroup named '<name> - <uuid>'; its canSave follows the road's state (false in Edit, true once baked/Live).

Profile presets (applyProfilePreset): highway, city, country, ledge, rally, race, speedway, valley. Each sets lanes, lane width, crown, shoulder, superelevation, engineering radii, road class and markings.
Default lane width 3.65 m (minimum 1.5 m); the roadway width = (lanesLeft + lanesRight) * laneWidthM, split into equal leftExtM/rightExtM. At least 1 lane in total (otherwise 1+1).

Element defaults: crosswalk depthM 3.5 m; repair lengthM 8.0 m, coverage 0.6, density 0.08, sizes 2 to 4 m, random seed; pothole radius 2.0 m, depth 0.3 m, noise 0.15; widening 3.0 m wide, bay 30 m, tapers 40 m and 25 m; intersection flare 4.0 m, length 8.0 m, bevel 2.5 m; barrier 30 m, offset 0.5 m, side 'right', type 'guardrail'.
The position t of placed elements is a normalized abscissa 0..1 along the centerline (plan length), adjusted by clampCrossingT to stay away from the ends (0.5 m clearance, or mid-road if too short).

Rebuild order of an active road (not being dragged): sampleCenterline, rib points, then meshMgr.updateMesh, sidewalkMgr.updateGroup, barrierMgr.updateGroup, be:reloadCollision, recreateAutoGeneratedLayers, layerMgr.updateAllLayers (decals drape over the collision, hence the collision before them). During a drag (dragging) or with previewMesh == false, only buildRibbonEdges is called. A terrain road (isMesh == false) uses buildTerrainEdges and terrain painting.

New group defaults: geometryMode 'engineered' (engRadiusM 40, engTransM 15, engVertLenM 40), latRes 16, lonRes 100, LOD 400/150/40 px, chunkLenM 120, material 'm_asphalt_new_01', US-style markings, automatic layers: light tracks, centerline, edge lines and lane lines active.
deserializeGroup fills the default geometry 'spline' for old saves without geometryMode, while addNewGroup creates 'engineered'.

serializeGroup empties the derived arrays (divPoints, etc.) of the actual group before encoding; serializeGroupToTable makes a copy and removes the runtime keys (decal ids, previewMesh, terraBaseline) for the session file.

convertPathsToRoadGroups: the final message logs #paths - #groups as the number of ignored paths, which also counts already existing groups (potentially wrong message). It creates a group per path even if the path is too small (minimum size 10 m): these groups stay empty.
addGroupToGroupArray does not call computeIdToIdxMap; addNewGroup, removeGroup, splitGroup and joinRoadSplines do.

defaultCrossingDepthM.desc: Default depth (m) of a new crosswalk: 3.5.

defaultRepairLengthM.desc: Default length (m) of a new repair patch cluster: 8.0.

defaultPotholeRadiusM.desc: Default radius (m) of a new pothole: 2.0.

getGroups.desc: Current array of all groups (live references, not a copy).

getIdToIdxMap.desc: Table group id to index in getGroups().

getEditModeKey.desc: Edit mode key of the tool: 'heroRoadEditor'.

addGroupToGroupArray.desc: Adds an existing group to the array, with a unique name; creates its SimGroup folder if missing and sets its canSave (true if group.isEnabled == false).

removeGroup.desc: Deletes the group at index idx: restores terrain paint, undoes the terraform, deletes layers, mesh, sidewalks, furniture and scene folder, then recomputes the id map.

removeLinkedRoadSpline.desc: Deletes a group by its id (called from the deletion of a master spline layer).

removeAllGroups.desc: Deletes all groups (isIncludeDisabled = true) or only the enabled (Edit) groups otherwise.

isIncludeDisabled.desc: true to include the disabled/baked roads.

updateDirtyGroups.desc: Rebuilds each group marked isDirty (and the dirty layers of the others), then marks the session as edited. Handles disabled/baked roads, groups with fewer than 2 nodes (clean everything), mesh roads, terrain roads, dragging and disabled preview. Called every frame by the editor.

dragging.desc: true while dragging a node/gizmo: only the ribbon edges are rebuilt.

rebuildSurfaceOnly.desc: Light rebuild for groundmodel painting: redoes the mesh (mesh.updateMesh) and reloads the collision. Does nothing if the road is disabled, of terrain type, without preview or has fewer than 2 nodes.

clearGroupVisuals.desc: Hides during a drag: deletes the group's mesh, sidewalks, furniture and decals (the layer definitions are kept) and reloads the collision if a mesh existed.

setFixedWidth.desc: Sets the same width on all the group's nodes and marks it dirty. Overwritten by syncProfileWidth at the next rebuild (the lane profile is authoritative).

setLaneProfile.desc: Sets the number of lanes per side (and optionally their width), recomputes the roadway width and marks the group dirty.

syncProfileWidth.desc: Derives the roadway width from the lane profile: normalizes lanesLeft/lanesRight (integers >= 0, at least 1 lane in total), clamps laneWidthM to a 1.5 m minimum, sets leftExtM/rightExtM and the width of each node.

applyProfilePreset.desc: Applies a profile preset to the group (copies all its fields, resyncs the width, marks dirty). Does nothing if the key is unknown.

conformGroupToTerrain.desc: One-off "Drape to Terrain": sets the z height of each node to that of the terrain (core_terrain.getTerrainHeight) and marks dirty.

isOneWayProfile.desc: Indicates whether the profile is one-way (one side has zero lanes).

returns.desc: true if lanesLeft or lanesRight is 0.

recreateAutoGeneratedLayers.desc: Deletes all automatic (hidden) layers then recreates those whose flag is active (tire tracks, repairs, damaged asphalt, cracks, patches, centerline, edge/lane lines, edge fades), and marks the group dirty.

addNewGroup.desc: Creates a new group with all default parameters (see notes), its transient scene folder and its automatic layers, adds it to the list and updates the id map. Returns nothing: the group is found with getGroups()[#getGroups()].

name.desc: Base name; default 'Hero Road N'. Made unique by util.generateUniqueName.

ensureCornerArray.desc: Aligns the sparse array group.corners (per-corner overrides, false = auto) to the number of nodes: pads with false and truncates the excess.

copyGroupProfile.desc: Copies a group's layer profile: non-automatic (serialized) layers and the marking, edge and cross-section flags/parameters (lanes, crown, shoulder, etc.).

returns.desc: Copied profile, to pass to pasteGroupProfile.

pasteGroupProfile.desc: Pastes a profile onto a group: deletes its layers, takes the profile's layers and parameters (absent values keep those of the target or the defaults), marks dirty and recreates the automatic layers.

deepCopyGroup.desc: Deep copy of a group via string.buffer (encode/decode), with the derived arrays (divPoints, divWidths, tangents, binormals, normals, discMap) emptied. Used for undo snapshots.

deepCopyAllGroups.desc: Deep copy of the state of all groups.

splitGroup.desc: Cuts a road at the selected node. Loop: becomes a reordered open road. Otherwise: creates two new groups '(1)' and '(2)' (new ids, corner overrides kept, terraform baseline cleared) and deletes the old one.

groupIdx.desc: Index of the group in getGroups().

joinRoadSplines.desc: Joins two open roads into one: modifies group 1 with the joined geometry (geom.joinSplineGeometry), deletes group 2 and clears the terraform baseline. Does nothing if the indices are invalid.

convertPathsToRoadGroups.desc: Converts paths traced from an image (terrain bitmap) into Hero Road groups: grid points converted to world coordinates, normals taken from the terrain.

paths.desc: Paths { points = {{x, y}, ...}, widths = {...} } in terrain grid coordinates.

serializeGroup.desc: Serializes a group to a string.buffer blob after emptying its derived arrays (modifies the actual group).

deserializeGroup.desc: Deserializes a group from a string.buffer blob or a session JSON table: fills missing fields with defaults (old saves), rehydrates the layers, converts nodes/normals to vec3 and marks dirty.

isCreateObject.desc: Flag passed by the caller (inferred from code).

serializeGroupToTable.desc: A group as a simple portable table for the session file: copy by the codec, without runtime keys, layers reduced to their author data.

deserializeSessionGroup.desc: Deserialization when loading a session: if the road is baked but its .dae files have disappeared, it is reloaded in editable mode (isEnabled = true, bakedManifest cleared).

gt.desc: Group table read from the session file.

recomputeIdMap.desc: Recomputes the id to index map (called by the session helper after a load).

singleGroupEditUndo.desc: Undoes a change to a single group: restores the data.old state (layers, parameters, placed elements) in the group with the same id.

singleGroupEditRedo.desc: Redoes a change to a single group: applies the data.new state.

transGroupEditUndo.desc: Undoes a change touching several groups: deletes all groups and restores the copies from groupsData.old, all marked dirty.

groupsData.desc: History data { old, new } (lists of groups).

getCurrentRoadSplineList.desc: List of enabled (Edit) roads as { name, id, type = 'Hero Road' }.

crossingFrame.desc: World frame of a crosswalk at normalized abscissa t01: center and ends of the roadway edges (p0 left, p1 right). Drives the placement ghost, the handles and the zebra strip. nil if the geometry is not ready.

tForPointOnGroup.desc: Normalized abscissa of a world point projected (in plan) onto the centerline, adjusted away from the ends. Used when dragging a handle. nil if the road has no ribbon.

depthM.desc: Extent along the road used for the adjustment.

clampCrossingT.desc: Clamps a normalized abscissa so that the strip (plus 0.5 m clearance) stays away from both ends; on a road that is too short, returns 0.5.

addCrossing.desc: Adds a crosswalk at abscissa t01 ({ id, name, t, depthM 3.5, lateral 'carriageway' }) and marks dirty.

removeCrossing.desc: Deletes the crosswalk at index idx and marks the group dirty.

addRepair.desc: Adds a repair patch cluster (scatter of asphalt decals, random seed) at abscissa t01 and marks dirty.

removeRepair.desc: Deletes the repair patch cluster at index idx.

addPothole.desc: Adds a procedural pothole (carved into the mesh) at abscissa t01; the adjustment extent is about the diameter.

returns.desc: The created pothole (lateralM, lengthM, widthM, depthM, noise, cutMarkings, seed).

removePothole.desc: Deletes the pothole at index idx.

addWidening.desc: Adds a flat widening on one side (layby, overtaking lane) at abscissa t01, with smoothed entry and exit tapers.

returns.desc: The created widening (side, widthM, bayLenM, taperInM, taperOutM, edgeBulge, laneDivider).

removeWidening.desc: Deletes the widening at index idx.

wideningDefaults.desc: Default values of a new widening (also the reset values of the sliders).

wideningExtent.desc: Total extent (m) along the road of a widening: entry taper + bay + exit taper.

addJunction.desc: Adds an intersection (funnel flare on one side, this road being the trunk) at abscissa t01, with options giveWay, exitCenterline and breakEdge.

returns.desc: The created intersection (flareM, lengthM, bevelM, side...).

removeJunction.desc: Deletes the intersection at index idx.

junctionDefaults.desc: Default values of a new intersection (also the reset values of the sliders).

junctionExtent.desc: Total extent (m) of an intersection: near bevel + throat + far bevel (2*bevelM + lengthM). Used for adjustment and meshing via the correspondence with the widening.

addBarrier.desc: Adds a placeable barrier segment (guardrail, jersey or plastic) on one side, over a length window, at abscissa t01; the furniture is placed by barrierMgr after the rebuild.

returns.desc: The created barrier (side, lengthM, offsetM, zOffsetM, type).

removeBarrier.desc: Deletes the barrier at index idx.

barrierDefaults.desc: Default values of a new barrier.

barrierExtent.desc: Extent along the road (m) of a barrier segment, i.e. its length; used to keep it away from the ends.
